steps.title: Define App Metadata and Configuration
steps.description: Configure app meta-information such as app name and package name in app-meta.json.

steps.title: Configure Root Gradle Settings
steps.description: Set up project-level name and subproject structures within settings.gradle.

steps.title: Define Buildscript Dependencies
steps.description: Configure root build.gradle to fetch resources from Google and Maven Central with Android Gradle Plugin version 8.3.2.

steps.title: Configure App-Level Build Script
steps.description: Set compiler and target versions to Android SDK 34, and Java version compatibility to Java 8.

steps.title: Set Up Android Application Manifest
steps.description: Declare the main application activity with proper namespace validation and set the main action launcher.

steps.title: Define Material Color Palette
steps.description: Specify material-design compatible white, dark, gray, and modern primary blue colors inside colors.xml.

steps.title: Define String Resources
steps.description: Create string labels for buttons, text titles, hint states, tags, dialog structures, and input validations.

steps.title: Create Rounded Edit Text Background
steps.description: Design a shape xml drawable for the input text field featuring soft rounded corners and light borders.

steps.title: Create Premium Rounded Button Background
steps.description: Design a selector state drawable that changes shades on press event for active blue interactive elements.

steps.title: Create Secondary Outlined Button Style
steps.description: Design a light outlined grey shape with soft borders for cancelled or secondary action buttons.

steps.title: Create Card Container Background
steps.description: Create a rounded light gray background drawable to house modern note list items elegantly.

steps.title: Create Work Category Tag Badge
steps.description: Design a custom rounded light pink shape drawable for branding and highlighting work tag badges.

steps.title: Create Personal Category Tag Badge
steps.description: Design a custom rounded light green shape drawable for styling personal tag elements.

steps.title: Create Idea Category Tag Badge
steps.description: Design a custom rounded warm yellow shape drawable for identifying custom idea notes.

steps.title: Design Dialog Note Form Layout
steps.description: Implement a customized interactive dialogue form structure inside dialog_note.xml to add and edit records.

steps.title: Implement Adaptive List Item Structure
steps.description: Design layout parameters for separate note card preview items including actions, badges, titles, and dates.

steps.title: Design Application UI Dashboard
steps.description: Structure the main landing display in activity_main.xml featuring stats, real-time live search edit-text, scrollable filter widgets, and ListView.

steps.title: Create Structured Data Model Class
steps.description: Implement Note.java as a data carrier container with structured properties and default constructors.

steps.title: Implement Built-In SQLite Storage Helper
steps.description: Write DatabaseHelper.java extending SQLiteOpenHelper for efficient creation, database access, and CRUD processes.

steps.title: Design Note Listing BaseAdapter Class
steps.description: Implement NoteAdapter.java using customized inflation logic, interactive callbacks, and category tag coloring.

steps.title: Implement Main Native Dashboard Controller
steps.description: Write MainActivity.java supporting live search query filters, category tags, interactive CRUD dialogs, and native shares.

steps.title: Building Quick Notes
steps.description: Compile raw resources and build the final native Android application package.
